# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 11 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 11
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. But let us also inquire whether the Lord took care to foreshadow concerning water and the cross. Concerning the water, it has been written with respect to Israel that they would not receive the baptism which brings forgiveness of sins, but would build for themselves.
2. For the prophet says: "Be astonished, O heaven, and let the earth tremble greatly at this: this people has done two evil things — they forsook me, the fountain of living water, and dug for themselves a well of death."
3. "Is my holy mountain Sinai a desolate rock? For you shall be as the chicks of a bird that flutter about when their nest is taken away."
4. And again the prophet says: "I will go before you and I will level mountains and break the gates of brass and shatter the bars of iron; and I will give you hidden treasures, dark, secret ones, that you may know that I am the Lord God."
5. And: "You shall dwell in a high cave in a strong rock." And again: "His water is sure; you shall see the King in his glory, and your soul shall meditate on the fear of the Lord."
6. And again in another prophet: "The one who does these things shall be as the tree planted beside the watercourses, which shall yield its fruit in its season, and its leaf shall not wither. And all that he shall do shall prosper.
7. The ungodly are not so, but as the dust which the wind casts away from the face of the earth. Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the counsel of the righteous."
8. Do you perceive how he described the water and the cross in the same type? For it says: "Blessed are those who have set their hope on the cross, going down into the water." Because he mentions the reward "in its season" — then I will repay you; he says "its leaves shall not wither" — this means that every word which will come out from you through the mouth will through faith and love be for the conversion and hope of many.
9. And again another prophet says: "And the land of Jacob was praised above every land." This means: he glorifies the vessel of the Spirit.
10. Then what does he say? "And there was a river flowing on the right hand, and beautiful trees grew up around it, and the one who eats from them shall live forever."
11. This means: we go down into the water full of sins and foulness, and we come up bearing the fruit of the heart in our spirit, having fear and hope in Jesus.
